documentTypes.name: Identity Proof
documentTypes.description: Government-issued identity documents such as Aadhaar, Passport, Voter ID, PAN card, or Driving License.

documentTypes.name: Address Proof
documentTypes.description: Legal proof of residential domicile such as Electricity Bill, Water Bill, Rent Agreement, or Ration Card.

documentTypes.name: Income Certificate
documentTypes.description: Revenue authority certified annual family income certificate, salary certificate, or income affidavit.

documentTypes.name: Caste / Community Certificate
documentTypes.description: Statutory caste or community certificate (SC / ST / OBC / EWS) issued by competent revenue authority.

documentTypes.name: Education Certificate / Marksheet
documentTypes.description: Board examination marksheets, university degree transcripts, bonafide student certificates, or fee receipts.

documentTypes.name: Land Record / RoR / Khasra
documentTypes.description: Land title deeds, Record of Rights (RoR), 7/12 extract, Khasra/Khatoni records, or land tax receipts.

documentTypes.name: Employment Document
documentTypes.description: Offer letters, experience certificates, pension slips, or employment exchange registration certificates.

documentTypes.name: Scholarship Document
documentTypes.description: National Scholarship Portal sanction order, bonafide college letter, or bank passbook mandate.

documentTypes.name: Other Document / Affidavit
documentTypes.description: Notarized affidavits, medical certificates, court orders, or other auxiliary government proofs.
